1.name: Ashwini
1.lore: Ashwini is the star of transport and speed. It has a youthful, healing energy that rushes to aid those in need.
1.myth: The Ashwini Kumaras restored the youth of the sage Chyavana.

4.name: Rohini
4.power: Rohana Shakti (Power to Grow and Create)
4.lore: Rohini is the favorite wife of the Moon. It represents fertility, agriculture, and the material manifestation of desire.
4.myth: The Moon (Soma) spending too much time with Rohini caused the other wives (Nakshatras) to complain, leading to the waxing and waning cycle.
